message.content: {"items":[{"title":"European Working Conditions Survey 2010","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.10984","justification":"The 5th European Working Conditions Survey (2010) covers working conditions across EU member states and some associated countries, including many of the listed countries, during the early 2010s."},{"title":"European Working Conditions Survey 2015","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12660","justification":"The 6th European Working Conditions Survey (2015) provides harmonized data on working conditions for EU and associated countries (including most of the requested list) in the mid‑2010s."},{"title":"European Working Conditions Survey 2010, Multilevel Dataset","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12273","justification":"This multilevel version of the 2010 EWCS allows analysis of working conditions at both individual and country levels for many of the listed European countries in the early 2010s."},{"title":"European Working Conditions Survey 2015, Multilevel Dataset","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13293","justification":"Multilevel dataset based on the 2015 EWCS with country‑level information; includes most of the countries in your list and is squarely within the 2010s."},{"title":"European Labour Force Survey 2010 – Ad Hoc Module: Reconciliation between Work and Family Life","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.11195","justification":"Although focused on work–family reconciliation, this 2010 ad‑hoc module to the EU‑LFS includes indicators closely related to working conditions across EU member states in 2010."},{"title":"European Labour Force Survey 2015 – Ad Hoc Module: Work Organisation and Working Time Arrangements","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12623","justification":"This 2015 EU‑LFS ad‑hoc module covers work organisation and working‑time arrangements, directly related to working conditions, for many of the specified European countries."},{"title":"International Social Survey Programme: Work Orientations IV – ISSP 2015","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12637","justification":"ISSP Work Orientations IV (2015) includes items on job conditions, security, and work environment, with participation from several of the listed European countries in the 2010s."},{"title":"European Company Survey 2013","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12143","justification":"The 2013 European Company Survey focuses on workplace practices, employee participation and working time in establishments across many EU countries, providing establishment‑side data on working conditions in the 2010s."},{"title":"European Company Survey 2015 (pilot / follow‑up components)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13168","justification":"This dataset contains 2015 survey material on companies and workplace practices, relevant to working conditions across several European countries in the mid‑2010s."},{"title":"Working Conditions in the European Union 2010–2015: Trend File (based on European Working Conditions Surveys)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13294","justification":"Trend file combining EWCS waves over 2010–2015, allowing comparative analysis of changes in working conditions during the first half of the 2010s for many of the countries you listed."}]}
